title: The long road
text:
The road out of the valley is long. Pack well before you leave.
The first night is the hardest. Find a hill, dig in, and light the place up before the sun goes down.
On the second day you reach the river. Follow it north until the trees thin out.
After that the plains open up, and there is no shelter for a long way. Carry wood with you.
At the far edge of the plains the old fort waits. Report there when you arrive.
